create_mask2former_segmentation_model: create a Mask2FormerForUniversalSegmentation model for instance, semantic, or panoptic image segmentation
build_mask2former_base_model: build a Mask2FormerModel base model to extract encoder, pixel decoder, and transformer decoder features from images
test_hungarian_matcher: test the Mask2FormerHungarianMatcher to compute bipartite matching between predicted masks and ground truth labels
run_mask2former_loss: run the Mask2FormerLoss to compute cross-entropy, mask, and dice losses with Hungarian matching for training
review_pixel_decoder: review the Mask2FormerPixelDecoder multi-scale deformable attention decoder that produces mask features and multi-scale feature maps
